The Oil Press squeezes seeds into Seed Oil and Press Cake, using 16 FE/t.
| Seed | Seed Oil | Press Cake |
| Soybeans | 150 mB | 1 |
| Rapeseeds | 125 mB | 1 |
| Flax Seeds | 80 mB | 1 |
| Wheat, Beetroot, Melon, Pumpkin, Sorghum or Hop Seeds | 25 mB | 50% |
The oil leaves through output faces (or fill a bucket from it); the cake comes out with auto-eject. Speed and Energy upgrades work.
Rubber Dandelion Roots press into 100 mB of Latex.

# Seed Oil
A thick vegetable oil. It lubricates the Steam and Gas Turbine Arrays just like Heavy Oil: put it in through a lubricant port. A turbine's lubricant tank holds one kind at a time.
# Press Cake
What's left of the seeds. The Compost Bin takes it (as much as a crop).
